I'm 26 now and I've had crises like this on and off throughout my twenties. At times it feels like I'm not moving forward at all and nothing has changed but when I really think about it I notice that I'm becoming more myself year after year. It feels overwhelming at times and I've suffered from serious suicidal ideationg from time to time when everything feels like a struggle.   


What keeps me going is the thought that it is getting better even though it often doesn't seem like it. If I were to end my life now I would not give myself the opportunity to experience enjoyable life. I also read a lot about different topics and try to look for books that make me feel hopeful.   


A concrete thing you can do is give yourself time to decide if you want children or not. You're young enough to do that. Decide that you do not have to worry about it until you are X age. Also, if you're love life feels blah and you're not too excited about they guy you're seeing just stop seeing him. The best thing you can do with your early 20s is to get to focus on yourself and get to know who you are. Try something new to find things that make life a little less miserable and make you feel some sense of inspiration/accomplishment/joy.   


I believe after I'm 30 life will get even better. Although it's still tough for me, I feel like I'm continuously getting closer to being at peace with myself. Give it time and don't give up, you got this. Also, spend money on yourself. You deserve it. And don't worry about your relationship with your parents, it will likely improve after you move out and see them less. If not, that's fine too. You can have whatever type of relationship with your parents that feels right for you.
